verdict.rationale: Viam documents a cloud-hosted simulated machine for configuring and testing without hardware, simulation-based training, and an RDK dummy 'fake' configuration. These give real isolation from physical hardware rather than a dry run. However, the docs frame simulation mainly as onboarding for users without hardware, not as a sandbox that keeps production data separate. missing for 10: documented separation of sandbox data from production org data, an explicit staging/sandbox environment alongside a production fleet, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: the setup wizard can also run your machine in a simulated environment in the cloud, so you can start configuring and testing right away
Build a palletizing cell in simulation and learn the core concepts behind every Viam machine. 90 minutes · No hardware required
Example with a dummy configuration: `go run ./web/cmd/server -config etc/configs/fake.json`.
